input.title: Improve character movement on slopes
body: ## Why this matters
Players report that the character slows down and sometimes stops on gentle slopes, which makes the first two levels feel unresponsive.
## What needs to change

Make the character keep its walking speed on slopes up to 35 degrees. On steeper slopes the character should slide down instead of standing still. The change applies to the movement component only, not to enemy movement.
## Acceptance criteria
- On a 30 degree slope the character walks uphill at the same speed as on flat ground, within 5 percent.
- On a 45 degree slope the character slides down and cannot walk up.
- The existing jump and ledge tests still pass.
## Verification
Run the movement test suite and the new slope scenarios in the headless engine build. Record the measured speeds in the pull request.

input.title: Add a pause menu to the puzzle game
body: ## Why this matters
Players who get a phone call have no way to stop the game, so they lose the level.
## What needs to change
Add a pause button to the level screen. Pressing it stops the timer and shows a menu with Resume and Quit.
## Acceptance criteria
- The timer stops while the menu is open.
- Resume continues the level where it stopped.

input.title: Detect invalid market data before model training
body: ## Why this matters
Models trained on bad prices give results nobody can trust. A single missing day or a price of zero can change a backtest result without any visible error.
## What needs to change

Add a validation step that runs on the price table before training starts. It must reject the table when it finds a missing trading day, a non-positive price, a high price below the low price, or a timestamp that does not increase.
## Acceptance criteria
- Each problem is reported with the row number and the name of the check that failed.
- Training does not start when any check fails, and the error message lists every failed check.
- A clean table passes without warnings.
## Verification
Run the validation tests with one fixture table per failure type and one clean table. Attach the test output to the pull request.
## Dependencies
Needs the price table loader from the data ingestion work.

input.title: Estimate the fair value of each holding
body: ## Why this matters
The portfolio team needs one comparable value per holding before it rebalances.
## What needs to change
Use a DCF model with the WACC set per sector, and show the fair value next to the market price.
## Acceptance criteria
- Every holding has a fair value or a clear reason why none could be computed.
- The sector rates are listed on the result page.
## Verification
Compare three holdings against a spreadsheet calculation that the finance team already trusts.

input.title: Detect data leakage between training and evaluation sets
body: ## Why this matters
If rows from the evaluation set also appear in the training set, the reported accuracy is too high and the model will disappoint in production.
## What needs to change

Add a check that compares the training and evaluation sets before each experiment run. The check looks for identical rows and for rows that share the same customer identifier. It stops the run when it finds either.
## Acceptance criteria
- The check reports how many rows overlap and which key matched.
- A run with overlapping rows stops before training begins and says why.
- A run with no overlap starts as before.
## Verification
Run the unit tests for the check with one fixture that has overlapping rows and one that does not. Run the experiment script once on the sample data and confirm it starts.

input.title: Fix the random seed so training runs can be repeated
body: ## Why this matters
Two runs of the same experiment give different scores, so we cannot tell a real improvement from noise.
## What needs to change
Set one seed at the start of the training script and pass it to the data shuffling and to the model initialization.
## Verification
Run the script twice with the same seed and compare the scores.

input.title: Keep unsent drafts when the app is closed
body: ## Why this matters
Half-written messages are lost when the system closes the app to free memory, and people have to start again.
## What needs to change

Save the current draft on the device every time the text changes and when the app moves to the background. Restore it the next time the compose screen opens. Delete the saved draft after the message is sent.
## Acceptance criteria
- Closing the app from the task switcher and opening it again shows the same draft.
- A sent message does not come back as a draft.
- Drafts stay on the device and are removed when the person signs out.
## Verification
Run the new interface test on a simulator and on a physical phone, and record the two results separately.

input.title: Rebuild the notifications screen, add dark mode and migrate the database
body: ## Why this matters
The notifications screen is slow, the app has no dark theme, and the old database format is going away.
## What needs to change
Rebuild the notifications screen with a list that loads page by page. Add a dark color theme to every screen. Move the stored data to the new database format and delete the old one.
## Acceptance criteria
- The notifications screen opens in under one second on the test phone.
- Every screen can be switched to the dark theme.
- Existing users keep all their data after the update.
## Verification
Run the interface tests for each screen and the data migration test on a copy of a real user database.

input.title: Add password reset support
body: ## Why this matters
People who forget their password have to contact support today, which delays them and adds to the support queue.
## What needs to change

Add a "Forgot your password?" link to the sign-in page. It sends a reset link by email that works once and expires after 30 minutes. The reset page lets the person choose a new password and signs them in.
## Acceptance criteria
- A reset link works once and then shows a clear message that it was already used.
- A link older than 30 minutes shows a clear message and offers to send a new one.
- The sign-in page and the email do not reveal whether an address has an account.
## Verification
Run the reset flow end to end in a browser test against the staging mail catcher. Check the three messages by hand and attach screenshots.

body: **Why this matters**
An empty file looks like a failed export, so people run it again.
**What needs to change**
When an export finds no rows, show the message "Nothing to export for this period" instead of downloading an empty file.
**Acceptance criteria**
- An export with no rows shows the message and downloads nothing.
- An export with rows is unchanged.
**Verification:**
Run the export tests with an empty period and a period that has rows.
